description: Knowledge matrix for His Final Target Book 1, tracking character knowledge states across the narrative.

Sloane.ch1: Has no memory of the past 3 months, knows only her identity as a firearms investigator and that her sister Mara was just shot.
Sloane.ch3: Has discovered seven lines inside the rifle magazine and heard a recording of her own voice tracing the wrist circle; suspects a past connection but cannot remember specifics.
Sloane.ch8: Has seen Lucian's scars and recognized him as her former lover; retrieved the second recording where she ordered him not to trust her restored self; knows she issued the contract for her own memory erasure and the staged shooting.
Sloane.ch12: Has identified Rook's reflection in target files and is in the process of unlocking the ledger; remembers all seven condemned names but has not yet read the ledger contents that fully expose Rook's manipulation.
Sloane.ch17: Has possessed the complete truth since chapter 13; released the ledger and her own contracts; is arrested and accepts the consequences of her actions.
Sloane.hidden_truth: Her conditioned muscle memory (the wrist circle) is the only key to unlocking Rook's complete transaction ledger.

Lucian.ch1: Knows the full contract terms, that the shooting is staged, that he killed seven people under Sloane's orders, and that Sloane's memory was erased; does not yet know that the seven targets were innocent witnesses manipulated by Rook.
Lucian.ch3: Has shown Sloane the contract and the rifle; begins to question the nature of the kills as Sloane starts recovering fragments.
Lucian.ch8: Has allowed Sloane to see his face and has been intimate; his emotional conflict deepens; still unaware of Rook's corruption of the target list.
Lucian.ch12: Witnesses Sloane unlocking the ledger; learns the truth about Rook's manipulation as the contents become accessible.
Lucian.ch17: Knows the complete truth; refuses the escape route and stands with Sloane at dawn.
Lucian.hidden_truth: He possesses the unedited recordings of Sloane issuing the seven execution orders and knows the sunrise clause of the contract that requires him to kill her if conditions are not met.

Mara.ch1: Knows she consented to the staged shooting and is alive; understands her role as bait in Sloane's plan to expose Rook.
Mara.ch3: Remains off the grid, in hiding; knows the plan and her later signaling role.
Mara.ch8: Has not yet made contact; maintains her apparent death.
Mara.ch12: Signals Sloane with hand rhythm showing the true firing sequence; knows the ledger is being unlocked.
Mara.ch17: Is alive; releases the ledger to the authorities as part of the exposure.
Mara.hidden_truth: She consented to the staged shooting and knows that Sloane's memory erasure and the contract are part of a trap to expose Rook, but hides her survival to keep Sloane in the dark until the truth is assembled.

Rook.ch1: Knows everything: he corrupted the target list, used Sloane's system to kill witnesses, and is manipulating events from off-roof.
Rook.ch3: Contacts the roof; continues his manipulation, lying to Sloane and Lucian.
Rook.ch8: Is still alive and active; observes Sloane's progress, plans to capture Mara.
Rook.ch12: Knows Sloane is unlocking the ledger; attempts to intervene via the blind interval and his control of the surveillance room.
Rook.ch17: Is dead, killed while reaching for the rifle at chapter 17; his network is exposed by the released ledger.
Rook.hidden_truth: He hid the transaction ledger inside Sloane's conditioned firing sequence and knows that if she completes the sequence, his entire weapons network will be exposed.
